title: Old task backlog triage after V2-9/V3 closeout

brief: Inventory old open/in_progress/blocked task tickets and classify whether they are stale, superseded, still actionable, or require owner decision. Do not change old task statuses in this slice.

notes: No old ticket statuses were changed.
